Let's implement it in the New Republic.|[[Airen Cracken/Legends|Airen Cracken]] and [[Wedge Antilles/Legends|Wedge Antilles]]|<ref name="XW:SoA" />}}
'''Adumar''' was a [[Temperature/Legends|temperate]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] located in [[Wild Space/Legends|Wild Space]] of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. Adumar was first settled by [[Human/Legends|humans]] in the [[Ductavis Era]], who had been [[Exile (punishment)/Legends|exiled]] from the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], and lived in isolation for [[Standard year/Legends|years]], and developed into several nations that spread across the world. Their culture became obsessed with the arts of [[blastsword]] fighting and [[Starfighter combat/Legends|starfighter combat]], to the point where skilled swordsmen and [[Pilot/Legends|pilots]] were highly revered. Their society also made considerable use of formal duels as means for settling disputes or even just for entertainment, and also had a rigid social hierarchy.

By [[12 ABY/Legends|12]] and [[13 ABY/Legends|13 ABY]], Adumari scoutships had ventured far enough from their homeworld to learn of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|struggle]] between the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] and [[Imperial Remnant/Legends|Imperial Remnant]]. As Adumar had considerable industrial resources devoted to manufacturing munitions, both sides were eager to gain an alliance with the world. Therefore, both the New Republic and the Imperial Remnant sent delegations to Adumar, each composed of elite starfighter pilots. The delegations were sent to Adumar's largest nation, [[Cartann]], and during their stay, the ''[[perator]]'', or leader, of Cartann decided to take control of the entire planet. While he had aid from the Remnant, the New Republic pilots escaped Cartann and rallied the other Adumari nations into the [[Adumari Union]] and [[Battle of Adumar|defeated]] Cartann and its allies. The Adumari also later routed an Imperial task force sent to aid Cartann and ultimately joined the New Republic. They would remain members of the New Republic and its successor state, the [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances|Galactic Alliance]], for years, participating in the [[Yuuzhan Vong War]] and the [[Second Galactic Civil War]], during which the world broke with the Galactic Alliance to join the [[Confederation]].

==Description==
Adumar was located in [[Wild Space/Legends|Wild Space]] with its [[Human/Legends|human]] population having a complex social structure which was based on personal honor and triumph over one's enemies. Adumari nobility was obsessed with [[blastsword]] duels and [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] combat, ignoring the underprivileged underground factory workers until the planet joined the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]]. The Adumari were also skilled in the manufacture of missiles, with several kinds being produced&mdash;including, for example, a variety which would penetrate through a solid surface before detonating, creating a large crater in the target. Their extensive missile production facilities could easily be modified into [[Proton torpedo/Legends|proton torpedo]] production, leading to both Imperial and New Republic interest in wooing the planet. However, the Adumari lacked a planetary government and were instead divided into several nation-states, though the most powerful was [[Cartann]]'s nation. Cartann also controlled several smaller nations through diplomatic treaties and alliances.<ref name="XW:SoA" />

==History==
===Early history===
In the [[Ductavis Era]], Adumar was settled by a group of humans that had been defeated by the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and banished. During this long period of isolation from galactic civilization, Adumari civilization would develop into that of various states which fought each other. Adumari nobility was obsessed with [[blastsword]] duels and [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] combat, and were also skilled in the manufacture of missiles which could easily be modified into [[Proton torpedo/Legends|proton torpedoes]].<ref name="XW:SoA" />

[[File:Adumarbattle.jpg|thumb|left|250px|The [[Battle of Adumar]].]]

===Galactic Civil War===
In the years [[12 ABY/Legends|12]] to [[13 ABY/Legends|13 ABY]], Adumari scoutships had ventured far enough into inhabited space to have learned what had taken place in the wider galaxy during their isolation, most notably of the ongoing [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] between the New Republic and the [[Imperial Remnant/Legends|Imperial Remnant]]. In the aftermath of the [[Orinda campaign]], the New Republic and the Remnant learned that Adumar was an industrial powerhouse manufacturing missiles, and both sides saw the strategic importance the planet possessed if they could bring it to their camp.<ref name="XW:SoA" />

However, negotiation by diplomats would be impossible due to the Adumari reverence for military heroes. The [[Perator]] of Cartann [[Pekaelic ke Teldan]] offered both governments the chance to prove themselves with the winner earning the allegiance of Adumar and its valuable missile industrial powerhouse. The New Republic sent [[General/Legends|General]] [[Wedge Antilles/Legends|Wedge Antilles]] of the famed [[Rogue Squadron/Legends|Rogue Squadron]] while the Imperials dispatched [[Turr Phennir/Legends|Turr Phennir]], who had assumed control over the legendary [[181st Imperial Fighter Wing/Legends|181st Imperial Fighter Wing]].<ref name="XW:SoA" />

Soon after, the Perator of Cartann, with nudging by rogue New Republic [[Diplomat/Legends|diplomat]] [[Tomer Darpen/Legends|Tomer Darpen]], declared that he was creating a planetary government controlled by Cartann. When representatives of the smaller Adumari states opposed Cartann, the Perator declared war, beginning the [[Adumari Civil War]]. When the Perator asked the Imperial and New Republic pilots to support Cartann in the conflict, Phennir agreed, while Antilles refused. In response, Darpen tricked the ruler into believing that Antilles and his pilots wanted an honorable death in combat with the to avoid the shame of having to refuse. After escaping the Cartann forces Antilles came in contact with the developing [[Adumari Coalition]] and agreed to lead their combined armies in an attack on Cartann. Following the successful attack Darper was arrested and The Perator abdicated the throne in favor of his son, [[Balass ke Teldan]]. Balass ke Teldan settled an agreement with the other Adumari state leaders, and the various Adumari nations united under the [[Adumari Union]], a government supportive of the New Republic.<ref name="XW:SoA" />

Following the establishment of the planetary government, the Remnant attacked the planet, beginning the [[Battle of Adumar]]. The combined New Republic and Adumari Union forces were able to repel the Imperial invasion.<ref name="XW:SoA" /> In retaliation, Imperial [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Gilad Pellaeon/Legends|Pellaeon]] later [[Campaign against Adumar|attacked]] Adumar and [[Orbital bombardment/Legends|bombarded]] the planet with the [[Super Star Destroyer/Legends|Super Star Destroyer]] [[Reaper (Executor-class)|''Reaper'']].<ref name="TNEGtC">''[[The New Essential Guide to Characters]]'', Admiral Gilad Pellaeon entry</ref>

[[File:Adumar_Crimson_Empire_III.png|thumb|right|320px|[[Nom Anor]] incites anti-[[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] riots to a small crowd in a town square.]]
The [[Yuuzhan Vong]] agent [[Nom Anor]] incited anti-Republic riots on the world in the months following its allying with the New Republic.<ref name="CE3">[[Crimson Empire III: Empire Lost 2|''Crimson Empire III: Empire Lost'' 2]]</ref>

Near the end of the Galactic Civil War, in [[17 ABY/Legends|17 ABY]], the Imperial Remnant launched the [[Imperial Skirmishes|last major Imperial campaign]] against the New Republic. Admiral Pellaeon fought a victorious [[Battle of Adumar (17 ABY)|battle]] at Adumar but the Imperial forces were eventually defeated, forced to negotiate [[Pellaeon–Gavrisom Treaty|peace]] with the New Republic [[19 ABY/Legends|two years later]].<ref name="TEA" />

===Yuuzhan Vong War and later history===
In [[26 ABY/Legends|26 ABY]], during the [[Yuuzhan Vong War]], Adumari forces launched a [[Battle of the Ten Tempests system|flanking maneuver]] against the [[Yuuzhan Vong]] near the [[Bilbringi system/Legends|Bilbringi system]], aiding in the repulsion of the Vong from the Galactic Core.<ref name="BP">''[[The New Jedi Order: Balance Point]]''</ref>

In [[40 ABY/Legends|40 ABY]], Adumar became allied with [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]] at the start of the [[Second Galactic Civil War]]. That year, [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Darth Caedus|Jacen Solo]] and his apprentice [[Ben Skywalker]] were sent on a [[Mission to Adumar|mission]] to uncover an illegal missile factory on the planet Adumar. The mission ended in a violent ambush, from which both Jedi narrowly escaped with their lives.<ref name="Betrayal" /> The incident sparked political unrest that threatened to ignite into total [[Confederation|rebellion]] and shatter the young [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances|Galactic Alliance]].<ref name="Exile" />

==Behind the scenes==
The name "Adumar" is derived from [[Wikipedia:Alexandre Dumas, père|Alexandre Dumas]], the French author who wrote ''[https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/The_Three_Musketeers The Three Musketeers]''. Aaron Allston revealed this during a panel at Jedi-Con in 2004, alluding to similarities between the main characters of ''The Three Musketeers'' and the four X-wing pilots in ''Starfighters of Adumar''.
